svg.title: H17 request completed
svg.desc: One retained cold H17 ace-resplit request entered 82,780 numerical states under its unchanged 100,000-state cap. All four values and the original recommendation were preserved. This is work versus a budget boundary, not a timing improvement or a guarantee for every shoe.
